    • of

      public static <K,V> @NonNull MLImmutableMap<K,V> of(@NonNull Map<K,V> map, @NonNull K k, @NonNull V v)
      Creates a copy of the given map with the specified key and value added.
      Type Parameters:
      K - the type of keys in the map
      V - the type of values in the map
      Parameters:
      map - the map to copy
      k - the key to add
      v - the value to add at the specified key
      Returns:
      a new map containing all entries from the original map plus the new key-value pair
